title: rhus cotinoides
intro: Rhus cotinoides, commonly known as Chinese sumac or Rhus chinensis, is a plant species in the Anacardiaceae family. It is used in traditional Chinese medicine for its medicinal properties, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial effects. The health benefits of Rhus cotinoides include its ability to relieve fever, reduce swelling, and improve blood circulation. The plant contains bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, including analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant effects.
